_comment: Apple Podcasts + Spotify stream counts from Riverside hosting analytics (Hosting -> Analytics). There is no public Riverside API for these, so update the numbers here manually when they change. totalStreams is the account-wide 'Total streams' figure. Each episode is matched to its YouTube upload by youtubeId (preferred) or by title; keep youtubeId set so the match is stable even if titles differ between YouTube and Riverside.
